context: Replaces the hand-rolled Display/Error impl with thiserror and adds a conversion from sqlx errors.
explanation: #[derive(Error)] generates the same Display output from the #[error(...)] attributes and keeps std::error::Error for free, removing boilerplate without changing behavior. The new From<sqlx::Error> lets call sites use `?` directly on sqlx results instead of manual .map_err() calls, and correctly maps the common 'row not found' case to a domain-specific NotFound variant. Clean, idiomatic error handling.
